notes.note: 12 clearances for Crippa with 18 contested possessions from his 34 (24 handballs).  A great turnaround from the last two weeks.
Cripps continues to get plenty of the footy with 26 disposals but he isn't converting it into big scores for us.
Not a big stat night for Cripps with just the 18 disposals which saw him drop back to the 60s for his equal second lowest of the year.

Cripps ended with a great stat line of 30 disposals and 21 contested possessions and 15 clearances.  This is four 110+ now in the last six games for him as he is making a solid run to the end of the season.
8 kicks and 17 handballs for Cripps as he led the game with 15 contested possessions. His first under 100 in the last three but he was not far away as he continues to post a great run of scores.

Cripps went head to head with Harley Reid and had a big game with 31 disposals and a goal. He had the most contested possessions in the game with 16. He is in a solid run of form of late and a good pick up.
Cripps racked up 31 touches and led the game with 16 contested possessions. The skipper has been over 110 in 5 of his last 6 now.
This was Crippa's first under 100 in the last five games as he was tagged by Setterfield. His score wasn't great for three quarters but a 41 point last really boosted him.
Cripps stood up and kicked the winning goal as he had 30 disposals and led the game with 8 clearances. His fourth over 110 in a row.
Cripps starred with 29 disposals and 2 goals whilst leading the game in contested possessions and clearances. Back to back 100+ for the first time this year.
This was Cripps best score this season but it was also just his third over 100. Of his 32 disposals only 9 were kicks. He did have team high 9 clearances and 18 contested possessions.
Cripps continues with his higher handball to kick ratio. 7 kicks to 18 handballs. Second lowest score of the season for him despite his 5 clearances which was an equal team high.
Cripps spent some time on the bench at a crucial point but his game was solid with 29 disposals and 9 tackles. But 4 free kicks against hurt his score. His value is dropping so you can wait on him.
Cripps was in his handball heavy game again with 2/3rds of his disposals being b hand. He was under pressure with 15 contested possessions and an efficiency of just 57%.
Cripps was one of the best for the Blues with this a good turn around from last week. His scoring can be up and down as he was aided by 19 of his 32 disposals being contested.
Cripps was trying to lead his team from the front but this game was one that shows he has a wide scoring range. Not one for your starting team.
